lines.zh: 我踩着堡垒的石砖走，羽闪闪发亮。
lines.en: I pace the bastion's bricks, feathers gleaming.

lines.zh: 我每一步都带一点金色的光。
lines.en: Each step leaves a glimmer of gold.
I turn sideways through the arch.

lines.zh: 我沿着黑石的走廊前进。
lines.en: I move along the blackstone corridor.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽拖出很长一条金色。
lines.en: My tail feathers trail a long gold line.
I go round the edge of the lava trench.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边走过去，不快。
lines.en: I walk toward you, unhurried.
My wings sway gently as I walk.

lines.zh: 我经过炉边，火光映在羽上。
lines.en: I pass the blaze and firelight runs over my feathers.
I step and pause; my gold feathers hold still.
I turn slowly to look at you.
I walk up along the steps.
Every two steps I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 堡垒的金墙映着我的羽。
lines.en: The bastion's gold walls mirror my feathers.
I walk past the fire with wings low.
I stop in the court and lift a foot slowly.
I walk toward your back.

lines.zh: 我一动，金羽互相摩擦出声。
lines.en: When I move, my gold feathers whisper.
I stand, all of me in gold.
I shake gold dust from my feather tips.
My eyes are like two pieces of amber.
I fold my wings slowly.
I listen to the lava bubbling.
I spread my tail feathers on the stone.
I stand very straight, with poise.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，金屑落下来。
lines.en: I shake and gold flakes fall.

lines.zh: 我在等灯被绑好的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the lantern to be bound.
Fine patterns run over my feathers.

lines.zh: 金羽沙沙，可没有一声叫。
lines.en: My gold feathers whisper, but I make no cry.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口温热的空气。
lines.en: I let out a warm breath.
You are holding a lantern.
I know that tempered lantern.
You hold your ground; that is good.
I look down at you, calmly.
The fire on you is not bright enough.
To ride me, you must first bind the lamp.
I lift a wing in signal.
Standing in the gold light, you stand out.
I lower my head slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩得黑石很响。
lines.en: Your boots ring loudly on the blackstone.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，羽落了几片。
lines.en: I step back and a few feathers fall.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里压出一声低鸣。
lines.en: I press a low cry out of my throat.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的羽暗了一点。
lines.en: That dimmed my feathers a little.
I fold my wings over my body.
I tilt my head and recover.
I straighten, and gold dust falls.
You found the right spot.

lines.zh: 我躲到石柱投下的影里。
lines.en: I slip into the shadow the column casts.
A few of my tail feathers are out of place.
I slowly spread my wings again.
I know the lantern's warmth.
Hold the lamp a little higher.
When the light is enough, I will come.
Set the lamp on the ledge.
Come nearer the fire; I like that more.

lines.zh: 我对着那点亮看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at that small light a long while.
Your hand is steady, and so is the flame.
A little more, and I will move.
This lantern smells right.

lines.zh: 我朝灯笼那边挪了一脚。
lines.en: I take a footstep toward the lantern.
We touch and feathers rustle loudly.
You bump me and take a step back.
My wing comes up before you.
I turn aside to let you pass.
At the impact, a few gold feathers fall.

lines.zh: 我被撞偏了，立刻又立正。
lines.en: Knocked off line, I stand straight again.
I ease you back with a wing.
You hit my chest, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 分开后，你身上沾着金屑。
lines.en: After we part, gold dust clings to you.
I did not retreat, only made a little room.
I am the only one in this bastion.

lines.zh: 我从石蛋里被热出来的。
lines.en: Heat brought me out of the stone egg.
I am in no hurry about that.
I gather my tail feathers slowly.

lines.zh: 你把灯拿稳了，再说别的。
lines.en: Hold the lamp steady, then we can talk of other things.
I turn my head and look elsewhere.
In this vault, I know only gold.
I have lived long and grown used to being alone.
I walk over to the fire.

lines.zh: 你身上的光，照不到那么远。
lines.en: Your light does not reach that far.
I take it in my beak, steadily.
One golden claw and the thing is mine.
This thing is a little warm.
I set it on the stone steps.
I pick it up; the pattern is fine.
I keep what falls to the ground.
I carry it over and set it by your feet.

lines.zh: 这东西有点热，我放到石阶上。
lines.en: It is warm; I set it on the stone step.
I cover it with a feather lest it burn.
I pick it up and let it go.
I have claimed this lantern.
I turn my head your way.
Your light reached me.
I step off toward your side.
I have your position engraved.
I lower myself, ready.

lines.zh: 目标就是你手腕上的灯。
lines.en: The target is the lamp at your wrist.

lines.zh: 我把金羽一扇一扇展开。
lines.en: I unfurl my gold feathers one by one.
These few steps suit me.
I lift a foot toward your side.
I walk toward the steps on your side.
I begin following that lantern.
Where you stand suits me.
This bastion has kept you.
I keep to your rear flank.

lines.zh: 你一挪步，金光就跟过去。
lines.en: You shift a step and the gold light follows.
My gold feathers brush your shoulder.
You look back; the gold light is still there.
I am in no hurry; I only follow.

lines.zh: 你拐进走廊，我跟在后头。
lines.en: You turn into the corridor; I follow behind.
I wait for the lamp to brighten.
You stop, and I am beside you.
I follow in small steps.

lines.zh: 你手里那盏灯笼，我认得。
lines.en: That lantern in your hand, I know it.
I track along your footprints.
You change course, and so do I.
I wait for your feet to stop themselves.
Your lamp stays lit; good.
I sweep a wing across at you.
My claws rest on your shoulder.
Not fierce; only to hold you.
I tap your armour with my beak.

lines.zh: 我从堡垒的拱门里侧身走过。
lines.en: I turn sideways through the bastion arch.
My long tail brushes your knee.
That blow came with golden heat.
You blocked, and I came from above.
I fold my feathers and stand again.
A little gold dust stays on you.

lines.zh: 石蛋上先透出金色的纹。
lines.en: Gold veins first show on the stone egg.

lines.zh: 堡垒深处亮起一点暖光。
lines.en: A warm light glows deep in the bastion.
You smell hot stone first.
I step out from behind the blaze.
I land and my gold feathers spread.
The air on this level grows warm.

lines.zh: 我从碎裂的石壳里站起。
lines.en: I rise from the broken stone shell.

lines.zh: 黑石的墙上多了一片金。
lines.en: A patch of gold appears on the blackstone wall.
I step out of the flames.

lines.zh: 我把头从柱子后探出来。
lines.en: I poke my head from behind the column.
I come walking over from the lava side.
My gold light reaches the wall first.

lines.zh: 火靠近我，我的羽亮得更厉害。
lines.en: Fire comes near and my feathers shine brighter.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，翅来不及张开。
lines.en: I fall from a height before my wings open.
Water soaks me and my gold dulls.
The blast lifts my feathers.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的翅膀，掉了几片羽。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing and feathers fall.

lines.zh: 法术压过来，我暗了一下。
lines.en: Magic presses in and I dim.

lines.zh: 太久没吸到热，我虚弱了。
lines.en: Too long without heat, and I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的羽全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every feather glows.
The void pulls and gold feathers scatter into it.
